articles.title: Candice Swanepoel turns heads at UFC 333 as Tom Brady dating rumors fuel the buzz
articles.summary: Victoria’s Secret supermodel Candice Swanepoel brought plenty of star power to UFC 333 in Abu Dhabi on Saturday night, turning heads at the Etihad Arena as the event made history with record attendance and the highest gate for a UFC event in the United Arab Emirates. The 38-year-old South African model was among the high-profile names drawing attention to the fight night, which also underscored the UFC’s growing international reach. Her appearance came amid renewed interest in her reported relationship with NFL legend and Fox football commentator Tom Brady. According to Us Weekly, a source says Brady, 49, has been dating Swanepoel “for a while.” The reported romance would mark another chapter in the seven-time Super Bowl champion’s personal life four years after his divorce from Brazilian supermodel Gisele Bündchen.
